title: rosa cinnamomea f. cinerea
intro: Rosa cinnamomea f. cinerea, commonly known as the Chinese wild rose or cinereous rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a shrub with fragrant flowers and is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rosa cinnamomea f. cinerea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the mind, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
